statement: A receiver-independent action bound gives quadratic peak and quartic startup-slew success-error laws.

requires: One arbitrary unknown, initially UNENCODED source qubit S,possibly entangled with inaccessible R,starts in rho_RS tensor tau_apparatus. Apparatus resources may be large or internally entangled but are initially product with input/reference. Actual independent inaccessible noise lambda*D[Z_S],lambda>0,acts from the stipulated input time with Poisson Z jumps. All other source-apparatus dynamics have a dilation commuting with Z_S except charged H(t),||[H(t),Z_S]||<=omega(t),A(t)=integral_0^t omega(u)du. This includes every noncommuting source interaction,control and physically implemented measurement. Source is ultimately discarded;receiver may retain all accessible quantum outputs/records,wait,compute and postselect,including whole-output processing. Hidden noise record remains inaccessible.
provides: For normalized Bell input Phi,J=(id tensor M_success)(Phi),s=Tr J ande=1-Tr(Phi J)/s. Uniform success p implies s>=p;reference-uniform conditional trace error eps implies e<=eps. No state-independent erasure assumption is used.

For any finite acquisition time and allowed receiver,0<s ande<1/32 imply s<=64*A(4e/lambda)^2. Peak envelopeomega(t)<=Omega gives p<=min(1,1024*(Omega*eps/lambda)^2). Startup envelopeomega(t)<=K*t givesp<=min(1,4096*(K/lambda^2)^2*eps^4).

Early hidden Z jumps can be moved to the input with dilation-amplitude discrepancy<=A(delta),independent of their count because parity only toggles noncommuting H. A common success contraction gives sqrt(s0)>=sqrt(s)-A(delta);one-jump wrong-Bell weight yields e>=lambda*delta/4. Comparison to the Z-commuting entanglement-breaking acquisition requiresA(T)>=sqrt(s)/8;the first interval withA(delta)=sqrt(s)/8 hasdelta<=4e/lambda. All comparisons precede success normalization.

The result charges actual source noncommuting access and applies even to unlimited downstream quantum memory/whole-output computation. An already-active coupling can have zero slew yet remain in the quadratic regime;the quartic law specifically requires startup from zero. A slew bound alone does not specify a hard frequency cutoff.
assumptions: This is a source-reported theoretical acquisition law,not a new Capital proof audit,hardware advantage or zero-capacity theorem. Input must be arbitrary and unencoded at the stipulated start;prior encoding changes the task. Known-state preparation,fresh-copy distillation,protected subspaces and task-specific measurements are not ruled out. All noncommuting source access must be charged;unbounded instantaneous measurement/control is excluded by the premises. Bell-input success can be state-dependent. The qutrit attaining exchange needs additional source transition access that an immutable longitudinal measurement port does not supply. Fixed startup slew is not hard spectral bandwidth. Actual bare-source hidden Z noise is required: cavity photon loss with jump a cannot simply be relabeled Z. New qutrit construction has analytic proof but no claimed executed numerical validation;moderate-bandwidth companion points are numerical,not interval-certified or experimental. Local initialization,flags,calibration,storage,extra noise and success-scaled instrument errors remain separate costs. Source says independent checks occurred within its run,but separate reviewer artifacts are unprovided;prior accepted scopes remain. Original P1 ZIP/full file uncollected under their boundary. Priority and competitive microscopic device performance are unestablished.
costs: For Bell-input success s and conditional Bell infidelity e<1/32,s<=64*A(4e/lambda)^2. Uniform success p and worst-reference conditional trace error eps imply s>=p,e<=eps. Peak omega<=Omega givesp<=min(1,1024*(Omega*eps/lambda)^2);startup omega<=K*t givesp<=min(1,4096*(K/lambda^2)^2*eps^4). Qutrit pulses attain the powers withsuccess constants1/128 and1/4096,under their stated additional access and small-area conditions. Peak-optimal pulses need slew pi*Omega*lambda/eps;fixed-slew pulses start at zero and have a separate peak condition. Arbitrary n-qubit acquisition at nonvanishing p and fixed Omega/lambda has Bell fidelity<=C/n+Omega/(lambda*p)*ln(n)*ceil(log2 n)/n,C=exp(2/e^2)<1.312. Deterministic high-fidelity register transfer needsOmega/lambda=Omega(n/eps);parallel exchange attains this dependence withn receiving qubits,n interactions and aggregate peak normn*Omega/2. Failures can consume the original input;no free retries.
